Cette page s’adresse aux personnes qui gèrent ces sites web : ce que sont ces requêtes et comment les refuser.

about.rules.title.description: Heading of the section of the server's information page with the server's rules.

about.source.title.description: Heading of the section of the server's information page that tells where to get the source code of the server's software.

about.title.description: Heading and document title of the server's information page, which everyone may read. {instance} is the name of this server.

about.retention.description.description: The server's maximum of the automatic deletion of old posts on the about page. {days} is the most days a post is kept.

about.retention.allowed.defaultMessage: Les membres peuvent conserver plus longtemps ces publications :
